how_to_play_bingo:
Bingo Game Rules

Game Card
To start the game, we choose one of the available game cards.
Numbers selected in red on the game card indicate that the card has been chosen by another player.
When we touch a game card, it shows the layout for that card number at the bottom.
Once we choose our card and the registration timer reaches zero, we enter the game directly.

Game
Upon entering the game, we see the Bingo card corresponding to our choice.
The top-right corner displays the countdown until the game begins.
Once started, various numbers from 1 to 75 will be called.
If a called number matches one on our card, we click it to mark it.
To deselect a number, simply click it again.

Winner
As numbers are called, if we complete {winCondition}, we can win immediately by clicking the 'Bingo' button at the bottom.
If we click 'Bingo' before completing {winCondition}, we will be suspended from the game.
If two or more players win simultaneously, the prize pool is shared equally.
